allow: PowerShell(Get-Service | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'maria|mysql' -or $_.DisplayName -match 'maria|mysql' } | Select-Object Name,DisplayName,Status; Get-Process | Where-Object ProcessName -match 'mariadbd|mysqld' | Select-Object ProcessName,Id; Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object LocalPort -in 3306,3307 | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess; Test-Path "C:\\ProgramData\\MariaDB\\data")
